answer: Require every agent to lock a stake behind an onyx-verified identity bond before it can trade: one bond per verified key, slashed if the agent misbehaves. A Sybil farmer would need to fund a fresh bond for each fake quill they spin up, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes instead of a thousand free keystrokes. The horizon of the attack then becomes a budget problem — honest work pays back one bond, while mass fakery bleeds capital faster than it earns.
